description: Incarn turns old photos into short, lifelike videos. Attach a family photo (or paste a public image URL) and the AI adds subtle, natural motion — gentle blinks, a faint smile, soft breathing. Made for old family and ancestor portraits. Prepaid credits, HD result, with a before/after preview right in the chat.

defaultPrompt: Animate this photo with a gentle smile
